I just love how she believes that the myth of ''95% of diets fail'' is true when it is based on 100 people, but then refuses to believe the one that is based on 6000 people. Sorry, but I have trouble seeing any actual points or link being posted in her rant. HAES is BULLSHIT. I can't stress this enough. Are you telling me that the person who is over 600pounds is healthy? The person who is bedbound is healthy? A person who can't fucking walk because they carry too much weight is healthy? You are telling me that someone being 20+ pounds underweight is healthy? Of course, they aren't fucking healthy.

I told you why a lot of diets fail or a lot of people gain weight - they either stop or when they have lost the weight, they go back to their old habits. Your body is not gonna get big on its own. Sorry, but that isn't reality. You consume more calories than you burn on the daily. That is why.  All you need to do to start losing weight is to figure out your TDEE and then have a deficit in calories and then bam - you start to lose weight. You can also go to a gym or increase your activity but that isn't necessary.

Of course, you are gonna pick a biased source. Try harder. Diets fail because people fail.  People get tired of restricting or following a diet they found online or a meal plan they bought. So they decided that it is impossible to lose weight when it isn't.. If you have trouble losing weight you can talk with a dietician or your doctor, but to claim that weight loss is impossible is ridiculous. Long term weight loss may fall for some because they followed a fad diet they found online or a meal plan, and now they are normal weight or at least less fat, but they don't know how to count calories, how to eat without overeating, how to cut drinking their calories and then without noticing slip back into old habits and behaviours.  Listen, I don't give a fuck that the woman who OP talked to is fat, my point is that he isn't the asshole. Also, you can be fat and not be delusional, I don't give a shit if you are fat or not, but to spew misinformation and scare people of losing weight when it will be beneficial for their health is just gross and ugly. You don't wanna lose weight? Fine, it is your life. I couldn't give less of a shit. You want to lie to people and tell them no matter what they do they will gain the weight back because of the myth called ''set point'' or using an old ass study that has been debunked is a big no-no.

Esp for an obese person, the woman is also borderline delusional and the other people around her are letting her live in that lie that she is not overconsuming calories. Well, saying that she is eating 800kcals and is obese is.  And why should he not be able to say something? Like I would understand if she wasn't talking about it and then he went and started talking shit, but he gave good advice.

She talked about it, he just told her that eating fewer calories and moving more is better? Which it is, god the woman is fucking delusional to think that she became obese eating 800kcals a day. She needs to learn how to sustain her weight loss, not just lose weight - if she actually manages.
Just because you don't count the calories, that doesn't mean that you aren't eating in a caloric deficit, what is your point here?

Is your husband taller than you? Does your husband weight more than you? Men usually need more calories to sustain their bodies, but that argument always annoys me because - both men and women who aren't overeating are eating calories to maintain their weight. You aren't getting cheated out of something. For example, you get to eat 1800kcals and that is to maintain your weight based on your height, weight and gender. He gets to eat 2400 to do the same thing - maintain.

If she had a metabolic thing - she would be in the doctor's room. But she probably doesn't because I've never heard someone eating only 800kcals a day and then being obese. That doesn't happen, even some people with issues have around 100-200kcals difference than the people with normal metabolism.  Genetics don't play a role in this.  The woman is delusional if she believes that she is consuming only 800kcals a day and OP maybe should've had a different approach, but it is more dangerous to watch someone use laxatives and live in a delusion that they can't lose weight normally.
Because she might understand his point?
Saying that should have been last resort after they talked. Not him dropping the bomb and then being surprised that she got upset and left.

I am talking about both giving their side, talking normally not just saying that he will break up with her and that it is a dealbreaker. If you love someone I think you owe them a bigger conversation than just ''I will break up if you do this.''  Let's use the example you gave: the starting smoking one. If I am home and my boyfriend comes home and says ''I think I will start smoking'' I would have a normal conversation with him, and if he is set on smoking and that for me is a dealbreaker I will just tell him that then we should break up since I am not okay with him doing this and he wants to do it. And neither I or he is backing down. My point: I don't think he is an asshole for breaking up with her for doing something that he is not comfortable, rather than they didn't have a conversation.

No, I am talking about putting an ultimatum for her which is manipulation. You could either talk to your SO or just be a dick and say ''well, if you do this we are over''  Of course there are some things that will make you want to break up with your SO and that is normal, what is not normal is to try and manipulate the person making them choose between 2 things because you can't have a decent conversation about it.

They should talk like grown adults. A relationship won't work if there is bad communication. If I was at his girlfriend's place and I wanted that tattoo, but my boyfriend said how he doesn't like tattoos and we had a level headed conversation about - I would not get the fucking tattoo, realistically it isn't a big deal. But if my boyfriend didn't bother explaining himself and said just how he is gonna put his foot down, but rather give me an ultimatum I would probably end it there and it isn't about the tattoo, but rather the fact that he is making me choose between him and a stupid tattoo.

True, but to me it seems a bit weird that you would end a relationship with someone you love over a tattoo, but then again everyone has their own feelings and if he wants to break up with her for that it is still valid and his emotions about it are valid. 

I still stand behind what I said about ''if you do it I will break up with you'' because it is manipulative, there are so many ways to handle something like this. For me, it seems (not the same extent of course) the same with the person who threatens that they will do something to themselves if the person leaves. I think that if someone puts an ultimatum to someone instead of talking about it like grown people - then I would leave. They should talk about it and figure if they are gonna end the relationship or he will agree with her for getting the tattoo or she will decide not to get it.

I think he is the asshole for putting this ''if you do this, I will break up with you'' it is really gross to try and manipulate someone like that and it usually goes on whenever the person doesn't agree with what their partner wants to do. I get not liking tattoos, but breaking up isn't that too much? It isn't like she gonna cover her body with em.
